title: Personal records from Garmin lap splits
summary: Race efforts embedded inside longer runs now count as personal records.

sections.heading: New
items: Best effort times are derived from Garmin lap splits, so a race inside a longer run counts as a PR

sections.heading: Improved
items: PR bucket tolerance widened from 2% to 5% so near distance efforts land in the right bucket

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Running events that match an actual Garmin run are no longer duplicated
